data.title: 焰影苇草 · 写好的信
data.description: 信里写了花园和最近的天气。她读过一遍，折好装进信封，准备明天寄出。
data.camera: 中近景，信纸与双手清晰
data.promptProse: Beside a sun-warmed window sill, Reed folds a neatly penned letter into a heavy cream paper envelope. A glass inkwell, a wooden dip pen, and a brass sealing wax stamp rest on the oak desk as sunset casts elongated amber rays across the room.
data.animaCaption: She creases the handwritten letter with gentle care and slips it into its envelope, pausing to gaze out at the golden twilight.
